activities.quote: Just wanted to keep everyone on point in terms of the importance and expectations of getting this King Ranch issue cleaned up for the prior months and correct on a go forward basis. Hopefully, if King Ranch is the part of the problem for March and we get these issues resolved, March will not be an issue.
